title: Understand revocation and recovery
when: Before disabling an actor or changing the last admin
need: Disabling revokes keys and browser sessions; enabling does not restore keys. Last active admin and protected service identities have restrictions. Revoke stops a pending invite. Reissue replaces a code for the same person; email resend requires revoke then invite. A lost one-time code needs Reissue, never replay recovery.
surface: Team confirmation/role refusal documented in public guide; actor CLI help.
review: Inline invite confirmations and source refusal recovery are tested; production proof remains pending.
